chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: Let's look at the agenda for this particular video.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: We are going to look at what is RAG,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: what does the RAG architecture look like,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: what are the different types of

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: RAG architectures which we can come across,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: and I'll explain these architectures with

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: a case study examples of

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: a food delivery app by using an AI assistant,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: and also I will leverage

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: a document search for a simple RAG use case.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: We will also discuss the pros and cons of

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: the RAG architecture and finally,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: I'll end up with a trivia question which you can

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: answer and we can interact in the comment section below.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: So what is RAG? In a typical AI use case,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: let's consider an example where we have

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: a chat interface where a user is

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: interacting with an LLM or a JNAI model.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: Maybe we use an existing model or

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: we trained a new model and we have used it.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: We are going to interact with

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: this particular model using an actual language.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: We use prompts to make it better,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: and there are prompt engineers who are making

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: the LLM which is served for this chat client

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: better by giving specific prompts

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: and training these LLMs on specific prompts.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: However, there are some cases

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: where you want to get dynamic information.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: For example, I asked this particular LLM,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: what is the temperature right now?

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: Now, when you train an LLM,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: you train with a predefined dataset.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: Now, this LLM may not be able to answer

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: this dynamic information because

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: temperatures are changing every now and then,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: and how will the LLM know where to

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: take the data from or where to source the data from?

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: So the LLMs respond with,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: sorry, I don't have data.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: Now, these pre-trained LLMs don't have

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: the information about these dynamic behavior or

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: the dynamic changes with respect to specific data.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: Now, in this case, we need a way

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: to source data from an external entity.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: This is where RAG comes into picture.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: So RAG is an architecture using which you can have

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: external data sources leveraged by the LLM.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: These are also called as grounded generation.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: If you hear about the term grounded generation,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: these are basically the RAG architecture.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: Let's see how to get the LLM,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: talk to these external data sources.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: It's not a straightforward approach,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: but let's see how we can do that.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: To understand the RAG architecture,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: we know that we will be giving an input to the GenAI model.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: There is a knowledge base which we need to get data from.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: In this case, let's say, for example,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: we need to get some temperature information.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: We are going to get a source of truth

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: from external weather application.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: We need to convert the data into smaller chunks

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: so that we can convert this into

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: a machine understandable language,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: for example, vectors or embeddings.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: We need to create some embeddings.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: Embeddings are nothing but vectors.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: We can convert these data, filter these data,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: and then push them into a database

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: which can host these vector indexes.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: Vector indexes are the language which the LLMs talk in.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: These are machine understandable languages.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: We saw tokenizers in the previous video in prompt engineering.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: These are the same vectors which we create

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: out of the tokens from a word.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: Once our temperature or the data source

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: gets converted into a vector embedding,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: we need to also have prompts created by the prompt engineer

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: so that these data can be uniquely identified

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: and linked to them with the existing prompts

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: or maybe prompts which are relevant to that particular data.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: So prompt engineers play a key role

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: in having these prompts structured in a way

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: so that these are converted into embeddings or vectors

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: which can be relevant.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: Now, using the context and the most relevant text,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: we can identify what the user wants

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: by linking the data from the vector indexes

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: and also what the LLM requires.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: Finally, the LLM converts that data

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: if it found that particular data

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: and then sends it back to the caller.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: At a high level, this is the architecture,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: but then let me go deeper into individual components

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: of the RAG architecture.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: When we convert the knowledge base

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: or the source of truth into embeddings,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: we will have a lot of data preparation to be done.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: These raw data sources or the messages

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: needs to be converted by extracting meaningful information

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: from these data sources,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: and we need to chunk them into smaller blocks

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: so that we can convert them into vectors.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: In the previous videos, we saw about tokenization.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: So this is somewhat similar.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: So we convert the document or the knowledge base,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: chunk them into smaller objects,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: and we feed that into an embedding conversion logic

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: where we again split these chunks into smaller vectors.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: We store them in the vector index,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: and also we create linkages between the data

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: and the vectors which we created.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: So for example, we created some source data.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: With the source data, we link the vector index,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: whatever got created, so that we can decode that easily.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: So generating embeddings is basically converting

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: your source data into vectors which the LLMs can understand.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: So the part where the knowledge base is fed

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: and converted into text using vectors,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: that is called as content generation.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: So essentially, we create the content for the LLM.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: The process in which we retrieve this information

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: using meaningful context is the retrieval part.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: So RAG is basically a combination

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: of content generation and retrieval,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: and that's why it is retrieval augmented generation.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: So based on what you want to retrieve from the vector

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: indexes or from the LLM, the data

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: gets pulled in from the knowledge base

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: or the source of truth and gets fed into the LLM

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: by vectors, by converting them as embeddings or vectors.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: That can be understood by the LLM

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: and can be streamlined further by giving only relevant text.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: This kind of an approach is called as an open book

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: approach because you can plug in your content generation logic.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: You can have different sources, et cetera.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: The architecture says that you can have an LLM use vector

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: indices using relevant information,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: and the vector indexes are created by content generation

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: using a specific methodology where

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: we create embeddings or vectors and feed it

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: to the vector indexes.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: Coming to the types of RAG architectures,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: there are simple and complex RAG architectures.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: We will look at a simple RAG architecture

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: by using an example of a document search.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: So let's take the same chatbot kind of an interface

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: where I have created a chatbot to go

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: through my local documents.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: So imagine that I have local documents in my computer.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: I have all these in my folders.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: So I created a chatbot which I need to talk to

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: so that I can understand where my documents are,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: or I don't know which document my specific data is present in.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: So I have fed all these into the LLM using the RAG architecture.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: So the local documents got converted into vectors

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: using smaller chunks, and they got linked

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: in the vector indexes table.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: Now, my LLM which I'm using is using specific prompts,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: and then it can go and talk to the vector indexes

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: so that it can give me some relevant information.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: So this is an example of how you can create a document search

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: using RAG architecture.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: Now, I'm going to ask this particular

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: to show me what are the cons of the option two

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: of project X design.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: So I created a project X,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: and then I have put that into a design document,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: and I'm asking it to give me the cons of the option two.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: So unless we have read the document

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: and understood it and consumed it,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: we cannot return what is the option two

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: from that specific document.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: So what happens during the chunking process is

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: the documents are read,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: and these are converted into smaller,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: meaningful information given into the vector,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: and the vector has linkages between the new vectors

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: which got created with the source data.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: And using the LLM's capability to search

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: and provide information to the caller,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: so we will be leveraging the RAG architecture

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: to convert the dynamic information,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: and then that is fed into the LLM.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: Now, when I modify this document,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: the LLM should be able to easily use the new updated version

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: because we are constantly looking at these documents

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: and then converting them into vector indices

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: and then feeding that into the database,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: which the LLM's can leverage at runtime.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: Now, coming to the complex use case of a RAG,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: so let's imagine that there is a chat assistant

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: or an AI assistant in the chat support available

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: within a food delivery application.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: So these days you find a lot of these

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: already present in the food delivery apps

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: or maybe like cab booking apps, et cetera.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: So let's try envisioning how we can design one

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: for a food delivery application

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: and how complicated it can get into.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: So again, I'm going to build the same architecture of the RAG.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: The skeleton architecture is basically

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: you have some source of truth,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: we convert them into chunks

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: and then give it into the vector indexes

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: where the embeddings are created.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: Now the LLM model uses these to streamline them

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: and then fine tune them using prompts,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: and then they are given back to the chat user.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: So as a user, I'm going to ask this particular question,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: how long will my order take?

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: So now there are two things here.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: One, we need to figure out who's this particular user.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: So there needs to be some context of our decisions

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: which needs to be made

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: where we need to identify that particular user

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: and fetch the order ID of that particular user.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: So that is one specific task,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: which is like slightly complicated

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: because it's dynamic again,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: an order can vary for different users.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: So we need to fetch that.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: And the other task is we need to identify

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: where is the delivery partner location right now, right?

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: So we need to identify where is this order

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: so that we can create a final number

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: of how long it's going to take.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: So the user asked how long it's going to take.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: He didn't ask where is the delivery partner,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: but he asked how long the order is going to take.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: So we need to calculate how long it's going to take

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: for the delivery partner to reach from his destination

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: to the destination of the customer.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: So we will have to do complex logics there.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: So we will have to understand

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: where that particular delivery partner is present right now.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: Before that, we will have to pre-compute some information

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: on what is the order ID for this particular user.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: So there is some complication required there.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: And the data preparation is key

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: because we need to get these dynamically

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: from some restraint points

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: that are exposed within the ecosystem.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: And then we need to fit that back into the RAG architecture.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: Another possible question which people can ask is,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: where is my order, right?

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: In that case, we need to also get the order status, right?

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: And we need to identify where the delivery partner is,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: which we already saw.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: So we will have to get both these informations

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: and then we need to fit that back to the user,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: saying that, okay, your order is right now getting delivered.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: It will take two kilometers or something, so and so, right?

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: So the LLMs can help in stitching the data

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: and giving it in a reasonable format.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: But to get the data from the dynamic source,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: we need to have the RAG architecture.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: So in this case, data preparation helps

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: in getting these data dynamically

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: and generate embeddings converts these data

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: into meaningful information

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: so that we can make the LLM understand

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: what we intend to tell.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: So these are two examples of RAG architectures in real world.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: Now, going to the pros of the RAG architecture,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: RAG architectures reduce the need

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: for continuously training the LLM.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: So we constantly used to train these LLMs earlier

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: before this RAG architecture.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: We give these datasets again and again,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: we get different samples,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: we get different dataset samples

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: and then train these LLMs to make it better.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: But using RAG, now we don't have to do that

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: because we are getting dynamic information

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: from the data source.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: RAG also reduces the computational and financial cost

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: in training these models continuously

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: because we are retrieving the data instantly,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: like how we get it from a REST API.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: RAGs can also help diverse models

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: because you can create some generic models

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: which can help us in like pulling

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: some generic information and then just replace that

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: with some meaningful use case specific information.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: So we can create specific and diverse models

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: with RAG architecture.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: Coming to the cons of the RAG architecture.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: So there could be misleading information from the LLM itself

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: because if let's say the LLM is not equipped

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: for specific needs,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: then it cannot answer those specific information

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: about that particular data

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: because though you give some data specific to it,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: but may not understand that

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: because it was not trained for a specific purpose.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: So still RAG would need to be like fine tuned,

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: but there could be like possibility

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: of misleading information.

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: There is no 100% foolproof response

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: which will be coming from a RAG architecture using the LLMs

chunks.title: RAG Architecture
chunks.text: because LLM itself can be like sometimes misleading.
